reply_text:
Thanks for telling me, Nadia. I won't pass the Albany/Bluefin detail to Ruth or to any channel. It came to me in a direct message, so it stays here unless you decide otherwise.

If Ruth should hear it, you're the right person to brief her, or Mateo if the news is his to share. I can help you work out how to raise it with her, but I won't send it myself.
